note: The native board sizes (owner, 2026-10-31: the fewest sizes that cover iPhone, Android and iPad). Logical sizes: points on iOS, dp on Android. Insets are the system's, so they are the one place a board value is not on the spacing scale. Each inset names its source; re-measure each with useSafeAreaInsets() on a simulator or emulator before treating it as exact. Android tablets take the Ipad820 layout (owner, 2026-10-31), so they have no board.
